userStories.title: Plan Skip the Crowds: National Park Alternatives
userStories.description: Curated roundup of 10 stays that pair overcrowded national parks with quieter alternatives. Target keywords: 'national park alternatives', 'less crowded national parks', 'alternatives to overcrowded national parks'. 10 stays across 10 states (VA, UT, MT, CA, ME, UT, CO, WV, OR, AZ), 4 regions. Organized by the kind of crowd you're escaping. Competitive angle: every competitor is a generic listicle with stock photos — ours pairs each alternative with a specific bookable unique stay with polaroid card embeds.
acceptanceCriteria: Target keyword identified: national park alternatives
10 stays selected with geographic diversity across 4 regions

Stays: stargazer-aframe-abingdon-va, escalante-yurt-resort-ut, glamping-montana, sierra-dome-arnold-ca, houseboat-nomad-pemaquid-me, hanksville-cave-home-ut, safari-tent-buena-vista-co, blue-ridge-river-aframe-wv, waterfront-aframe-rhododendron-or, coconino-aframe-flagstaff-az
